sections.title: Sound of letter ka
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (ка) /ka/. Its main sound is heard in the word (кот) /kot/, which means cat. This letter has three sounds in total.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: To make the first sound, lift the back of your tongue. Touch the soft back of the mouth, stop the air, and let it burst out. For the second sound, raise the middle of your tongue toward the roof. For the third sound, keep your tongue back, and turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading and spelling
paragraphs: You say the main sound before hard vowels, before consonants, and at the end of a word. You hear it in (как) /kak/. Say the palatalized sound before soft vowels and the soft sign. A palatalized consonant is said with the middle of the tongue raised toward the roof of the mouth. You hear it in (кит) /kʲit/. Before voiced consonants, assimilation makes the sound voiced. Assimilation is a change where one sound becomes like another. You hear this in (вокзал) /vaɡˈzal/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not puff out a big burst of air when you say this letter. English words like kite have an aspirated sound with extra air. An aspirated sound is followed by a small puff of air, like p in pin. Hold the air back tightly, so it sounds like the k in skin. Before soft vowels, make sure to raise your tongue toward the roof.
